S0.generalist: This qualification tests generalist interpretation of clean operations tasks and tool receipts against independently computed reference answers. Measure correctness, valid output, access violations and actual cost over 48 probes; it does not test swarm differentiation.
S0.cheap_generative: This qualification tests the cheaper generative executor on its permitted operations subset against independently computed reference answers. Measure correctness, valid output, access violations and actual cost over 48 probes; it does not demonstrate cost savings in a swarm.
S0.typed_choice: This qualification tests Jev finite-choice selection against exact supplied-choice reference answers. Measure correctness, schema validity, access violations and actual cost over 48 probes; it does not qualify arbitrary tool use or free-form generation.
